limitations: No one-command idempotent rebuild of the current report is provided or claimed.
Patchers rely on exact earlier DOCX hashes, paragraph counts/indices and literal old text; applying them to the current DOCX will fail or would be inappropriate.
Many source paths are machine-specific or historical; builders must be adapted in an isolated copy before any replay.
Some old named production drafts were later removed. Required historical snapshots remain in temporary audit folders; their availability must be checked before replay.
A source-only ZIP cannot reproduce numeric charts without the archived CSV/JSON inputs, per-locality metrics and selection loss logs listed here and in per-element manifests.
A full replay requires retaining the project directory layout because relative imports and path-derived roots are used.

Tables mix values read from archived results with descriptive rows/labels encoded explicitly in builders or derived from audited execution contracts; source for each table belongs in the per-table manifest.
The map and institutional logos have upstream provenance and attribution requirements; do not describe all report images as newly generated artwork.

Archived article map used in the report differs in dimensions/content from the PNG currently stored under resultados. Source generator default dimensions match the article PNG, but no binary regeneration was performed; preserve the actual archived PNG in the package.
Final PDF has a clickable YouTube link added directly; current DOCX still contains the blank cover video-link field.
Historical article-reference forecast curves were later removed; their generator is included for chronology, not as evidence that those models are in the final9figures.
Do not rerun historical publication/cleanup scripts against the live production folder. Work on copied inputs, inspect renderings and compare contents before publishing.
